from pathlib import Path
import sys,tempfile,subprocess,shutil,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); out=Path(sys.argv[1])
files=['scripts/v7/exp91/prepare_inputs.py','scripts/v7/exp91/common.py','scripts/common/experiment_paths.py','scripts/common/exp_utils.py','configs/experiments/exp91_input_reference.json']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='exp91-no-history-') as folder:
 clean=Path(folder)
 for name in files:
  dest=clean/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(root/name,dest)
  snap=out/'source'/name;snap.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(root/name,snap)
 (clean/'data').mkdir()
 (clean/'data/nfv3_energy_suite_uncapped_scenarios.pkl').symlink_to((root/'data/nfv3_energy_suite_uncapped_scenarios.pkl').resolve())
 assert not (clean/'tabpfn/results').exists()
 command=[sys.executable,'scripts/v7/exp91/prepare_inputs.py','--budgets','20']
 result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=clean,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
 (out/'isolated_preparation.log').write_text(result.stdout)
 print(result.stdout,flush=True)
 if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 comparisons=[]
 for dataset in ['cic2018','toniot']:
  name=f'{dataset}_original_fixed750_n20_s43_u10000_full.npz'
  p=clean/'data/exp91/inputs'/name
  previous=root/'data/exp91/inputs'/name
  with p.open('rb') as f:actual=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
  with previous.open('rb') as f:expected=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
  assert actual==expected,(dataset,actual,expected)
  md=json.loads(p.with_suffix('.json').read_text())
  comparisons.append(dict(dataset=dataset,npz_sha256=actual,byte_identical_to_previous=True,test_rows=md['test_rows'],label_counts=md['label_counts']))
 report=dict(passed=True,historical_results_directory_present=False,source_hash_check_bypassed=False,models_trained=False,comparisons=comparisons)
 (out/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
